request.initial_prompt: Hastings. I tell thee, man, 'tis better with me now Than when thou met'st me last where now we meet. Then was I going prisoner to the Tower, By the suggestion of the Queen's allies. But now, I tell thee—keep it to thyself— This day those enemies are put to death, And I in better state than e'er I was.
